messages:
Olu A. (People Ops): Heads-up: onsite for Neha Patel at our NYC office Tue Mar 23. She lands JFK 07:55 ET from Mumbai. Requests: later start (10:30), reduced echo in interview rooms (sensitivity), vegetarian lunch, temporary badge, parking permit if driving, and a meet fallback in case of customs hold-up.
Bea T. (Recruiter): Neha prefers 10:30-13:30. Asked for a 30m pause between tech and culture. No allergies; vegetarian. I'll ask about license plate and whether she wants a car pickup.
Marco V. (Office Admin): I can block Conference West and Quiet Suite. Will prep acoustic panels in the room and a lower-height desk in Quiet Suite. Need plate to reserve visitor parking. Catering: vegetarian boxed lunch at 12:30.
Riley H. (Hiring Manager): 10:30-13:30 works. Panel will be 60m design + 30m culture. Interviewers will join 10 min early.
Olu A. (People Ops): Expense guidance to share: originals preferred, photos accepted. For INR receipts add conversion note: "amount in INR converted to USD via xe.com on date". Airport transfer pre-approved up to $95. Submit scans to travel@redwood.example within 30 days.
Bea T. (Recruiter): Reached out to Neha about parking and pickup. She said shell take a taxi if company pickup isn't available. I'll send itinerary + Google Meet fallback 24h prior and CC travel@redwood.example.
calendar-bot: Calendar event created: "Onsite  Neha Patel" Tue Mar 23 10:30-13:30 ET  https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=neha123 (rooms: Conference West + Quiet Suite, Meet fallback: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij).
Marco V. (Office Admin): Parking hold placed; update plate when you have it. Acoustic panels and signs ordered. Quiet Suite kit: lower desk, spare laptop charger, dongles.
Bea T. (Recruiter): Plate = "TBD" (candidate checking). I'll update by EOD. Sent expense checklist and Meet link to Neha.
Olu A. (People Ops): Day-of checklist: 1) Confirm plate & parking, 2) Confirm ETA, 3) Send final itinerary + fallback 24h prior, 4) Ensure Quiet Suite setup. Marking this as the canonical day-of thread. Ping here for changes. :spiral_calendar:
